why_it_matters: This settles the last in-program closure candidate for the terminal face hOffCPT2 (0249/0251 residual ledger). The 0126 dissolution said the strip squeeze window is EMPTY IN BODY (t4l_bandEmpty) - a statement about the uniform n4 wiring. The day059 probe extends that fact to the ENTIRE per-point witness family: the two squeeze legs (S1 fill >= devProg, S4 wire < floor) close on STRICTLY COMPLEMENTARY sides of a pointwise knife edge C*(t, d0) = t^-2/(2 devProg(t, d0)) ~ 1/(8 d0^2 f), so no member of the family - C = 5001 included, whose S3/S4 closure (T4OffLC, 0250) is the strongest on the wire side - can close the S1 leg, and no C that closes S1 can close S4. The two-sided knife edge is not an artifact of the particular schedule: it is the same 1/(8 d0^2) floor geometry at the band edge that makes 5000 the 058e threshold, seen from both legs at once. Hence the per-point schedule is exhausted as hOffCPT2 machinery, and the completion layer for 'complete RH' is exactly the record layer (frontier push / external zero-exclusion record, route (A)): the in-program side is, as of 0252, COMPLETE AND FINAL in its analytic content (B10 body theorems + T4OffLB/T4OffLC off-board pins + this exhaustion map). The cross-validations (0244v2 island onset 0.008084; 058e threshold 5000; uniform-n4 edge S1 margin 1.15-1.36) confirm the ports are faithful. Honest limits: (1) the probe bounds the S1Ge fill from below by the phase-free triangle bound T1 - T2 - T3; the actual ||W_n|| equals T1 to relative O(n^-1) (T2/T1 ~ t/n ~ 10^-44 at per-point runs) so no phase headroom exists; (2) the C < 1 region extends by the measured exact 1/C / C proportionality (verified down to C = 1 with P5 runs still >> t); (3) the S4 leg is stated against the floor via the 058e wall (T4OffLC pins) - the in-body S4 is the uniform-n4 theorem (s4asm_residue_S4_covered) which the per-point wiring replaces at the cost of the schedule dependency measured here. NO RH claim: the terminal face remains open in the record layer; the endpoint theorem is unchanged and conditional, as before.
